releases.notes:
**TLDR:** `shaderboard:scoreboard_objective` bindings now pass `int` to GLSL instead of `float`. Please declare your inputs as integers in GLSL post-effect scripts.

### Technical changelog
- Backend & API overhaul. `v1.0`'s system was limited to all binding types being able to only pass `float`s to GLSL. This API overhaul allows bindings to pass various other GLSL types (integers, vectors, matrices, etc).
- `shaderboard:scoreboard_objective` now passes `int` to GLSL instead of `float`.

See updated [README.md](https://github.com/TheCSDev/shaderboard/blob/main/README.md) for more info.

### End goal
The end goal with these changes is to prepare the mod for planned features that are to come. From passing large blocks of scoreboard data to GLSL, to going beyond scoreboards and reading other variables related to the local player and the world around them.
